description: Describes a single property of a wireframe component. Drives rendering in the Properties Panel.

members.name: Category
members.description: Groups related props under a collapsible section header in the Properties Panel. E.g. "Content", "Appearance", "Behavior".

members.name: Default
members.description: Default value applied when a new element is created.

members.name: DisplayName
members.description: Human-readable label shown in the Properties Panel.

members.name: IsRequired
members.description: When true the Properties Panel marks this field with an asterisk.

members.name: Name
members.description: camelCase property key – matches the key in .

members.name: Type
members.description: Data type that determines which input control is rendered.

members.name: ValidationRegex
members.description: Optional regex validated in the Properties Panel (String type only).
